chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qasani, from Muhammad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Bilal, that he wrote to him (peace be upon him) asking about the twig (of the palm tree).

'When we cannot find it, can we make something else its substitute in a place where the palm tree cannot be reached?' So he (peace be upon him) wrote: 'It is permissible when the twig is scarce; and the twig is superior, and with it has the report come.'

key_terms.الْجَرِيدَةُ: The twig or branch of the palm tree, used for ritual cleaning (istinja).

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if palm twigs are unavailable for ritual cleaning?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith clarifies the flexibility of *istinja* (ritual cleansing) by permitting substitute materials when palm twigs (*jaridah*) are unavailable, while affirming the palm twig's superior status based on established reports. It reflects the Shia juristic principle of *al-asl al-suhha* (original purity) and the preference for natural, easily accessible items for ritual cleanliness. The ruling underscores the practicality of Islamic law, allowing for adaptation without compromising the spiritual ideal of using the Prophet's preferred method.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Ali Bin Muhammad Al Qasany, from Muhammad Bin Muhammad, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali Bin Bilal who wrote to him<sup>asws</sup> asking him<sup>asws</sup> about the twig, ‘When it cannot be found, can we make something else to be in its place, if the palm tree is not possible to get to?’
So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote: ‘When the twig (of the palm tree) is scarce; and the twig (of the palm tree) is superior, and with it has the report come’.
en.sarwar: 11. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Ali ibn m h al-Qasaniy from Muhammad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Bilal who has said the following: “I wrote to him (the Imam) asking about al-Jaridah (palm tree twig) if it is not available, can any other branch be used if palm tree is not available?
He (the Imam) wrote, ‘It is permissible if al-Jaridah (palm tree twig) is not available, but al-Jaridah (palm tree twig) is better; there is Hadith about it.’”
